scope: Isolated real Grok terminal and browser sharing one official leader through the exact native candidate

fixture.terminal: Official interactive TUI launched and controlled by Syl in its own tmux session; text captured from that owned pane.
fixture.browser: Chrome on a Syl hidden Sway compositor at 2560x1440.
fixture.provider: Loopback HTTP fixture returning deterministic text and two precisely bounded tool calls.
fixture.leader: Explicit grok --leader; same synthetic GROK_HOME and socket as the native adapter.
fixture.nativeHome: Temporary isolated directory, with Grok confined by bubblewrap to that directory and read-only Nix executables.

permissions.first: Browser prompt requests one fixed append to effect.txt; terminal and browser both show approval; browser reload preserves it; terminal explicitly selects Yes, proceed once; effect contains exactly one line.
permissions.second: Terminal requests exactly the same command again; it requires a fresh approval. Browser denial cancels the terminal turn; the effect file still contains only the first line.

negativeObservation.configuration: Clean Grok home without --leader or cli.use_leader=true
negativeObservation.result: The browser could load persisted history but the embedded terminal did not receive the subsequent browser turn. This does not qualify live control of embedded terminals.
negativeObservation.existingGuidance: TerminalSessionHelp and Spanreed doctor already require shared leader mode and explain finishing, exiting and resuming an embedded session.
